meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: Claude 能帮你查看、添加或移除 NanoClaw 代理容器可访问的主机目录（即“挂载白名单”），配置存在 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json。添加目录时会先验证路径是否存在，询问设为只读还是可读写，然后写入配置。
howto.when: 当你说到“mounts”“mount allowlist”等关键词，或要求查看/配置代理容器能访问哪些主机目录时触发。

say.text: 现在允许代理容器访问 /home/user/data，可读写。
say.note: 它会验证路径并写入白名单。

say.text: 把 /tmp/test 从挂载白名单里删掉。
say.note: 它会更新配置并移除该目录。

say.text: 当前白名单有哪些目录？是只读还是可写？
say.note: 它会读取并格式化显示当前配置。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you view, add, or remove host directories accessible to NanoClaw agent containers (the "mount allowlist"), stored at ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json. When adding a path, it validates the path exists, asks whether it should be read-only or read-write, then writes the config.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention keywords like "mounts" or "mount allowlist", or ask to see/configure which host directories agent containers can access.

say_en.text: Allow the agent container to access /home/user/data, read-write.
say_en.note: It validates the path and writes the allowlist.
It updates the config and removes that directory.

say_en.text: What directories are currently allowed, read-only or writable?
say_en.note: It reads and displays the current config.
